prespecified.pairing_rule: PLAN_2026-09-30: same team-season, opposite hands, >=150 PA each, >=20 starts each, co-start <=15%, LHB >=70% of starts vs RHP, RHB >=60% vs LHP (every qualifying combination)

refined_exploratory.pairing_rule: same team-season, opposite hands, >=150 PA each; over the overlap of their tenures (>=40 team games) exactly one starts in >=60% of games, co-start <=15%, LHB >=70% of starts vs RHP, RHB >=60% vs LHP; mutual best complementary partner

A7.note: The prespecified rule counts every qualifying left/right combination, so one hitter can sit in several pairs (up to 13 per team-season). The refined rule (added after the first results; exploratory) keeps each hitter's single most complementary partner over their shared tenure.
